title: Zesty Buttery Ethiopian Shrimp Fir Fir
description: A pescatarian-friendly Ethiopian dish featuring shrimp, dark chocolate, and a flambe touch, served in a traditional fir-fir style.
instructions: Melt 2 tablespoons of butter in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped red onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the shrimp and cook until pink and fully cooked, about 5 minutes.
Remove the shrimp from the skillet and set aside.
Add the remaining 2 tablespoons of butter to the skillet and stir in the berbere spice.
Add the torn injera bread to the skillet and stir to combine with the butter and spice mixture.
Add the cooked shrimp back into the skillet and stir to combine with the injera bread mixture.
Add the chopped dark chocolate to the skillet and stir until melted and well combined.
Add the rum to the skillet and ignite to flambe, cooking for an additional 2 minutes.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
